description: Add AI generation to the email Templates builder. Add a 'Generate with AI' sub-panel (prompt + optional image upload) to the template create page (priority) and, if feasible, the edit page, that POSTs to /api/generate-content with kind=email and drops the returned email-safe HTML into the bodyHtml textarea state for review/edit before saving (no auto-save). Depends on FEAT-001 (the route + email system instruction must exist). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Edit src/app/dashboard/templates/create/page.tsx (already 'use client'). Make the Email Body textarea controlled: add `const [bodyHtml, setBodyHtml] = useState('')` and bind value/onChange on the existing name='bodyHtml' textarea (keep the field name 'bodyHtml' and the required attribute so createTemplate still receives it). Add an AI generator sub-panel above or beside the body field: a prompt textarea (useState aiPrompt), an optional reference image <input type='file' accept='image/*' multiple> with removable chips, a 'Generate with AI' button (useState aiLoading -> label 'Generating…' + disabled), and inline error via <div className='auth-message error'>. Reuse the existing .landing-ai / .ai-files / .ai-generate / .field / .button classes for visual consistency with the landing studio.

Implement handleGenerate in the template create page: build FormData with prompt=aiPrompt, kind='email', and each file appended as 'files'; `await fetch('/api/generate-content', { method:'POST', body: form })`; on !res.ok setAiError(data.error); on success setBodyHtml(data.html). Do NOT auto-submit — the user reviews/edits then clicks the existing 'Create template' button which calls createTemplate. Keep the existing {{link}} helper note; optionally strengthen it to say the AI is instructed to include {{link}} automatically.

Edit page (src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/page.tsx) — priority-second. It is currently a server component using <form action={updateTemplate}> with defaultValue fields. To add AI generation it must become a client component managing bodyHtml state. Preferred approach: keep a thin server component that fetches the template (existing supabase query) and passes it as a prop to a new client child component (e.g. EditTemplateForm) that holds the AI sub-panel + controlled bodyHtml and submits via the updateTemplate action (keep the hidden id input). If this conversion proves risky or time-consuming, SHIP CREATE ONLY and record in findings that edit-page AI was deferred (create is the stated priority). Either way the edit page must still build and save correctly.
Confirm no auto-save and that generated HTML is editable: the generated HTML only lands in bodyHtml state; saving remains the user's explicit action via createTemplate/updateTemplate.
acceptance_criteria: The template create page has a working 'Generate with AI' control that POSTs to /api/generate-content with kind=email and populates the controlled bodyHtml textarea without saving.
The bodyHtml field name and the createTemplate/updateTemplate save flows are unchanged; generated content is editable before save.
Generated emails are instructed (via the FEAT-001 email system instruction) to include the literal {{link}} tracking placeholder so campaigns/actions.ts /{{link}}/g replacement still works.
If edit-page AI is deferred, findings explains why and the edit page still builds/saves.
`npm run build` passes and `npm run lint` passes.
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; confirm both pass.
Run `rg -n "generate-content|kind.*email|setBodyHtml" src/app/dashboard/templates` and confirm the create page wires to kind=email.
Manually confirm the create page textarea is controlled (value={bodyHtml}) and that handleGenerate does not call createTemplate.
findings:
DONE. AI generation added to BOTH the template create page AND the edit page (edit-page AI was NOT deferred).

Create page (src/app/dashboard/templates/create/page.tsx): made the Email Body textarea controlled via `const [bodyHtml, setBodyHtml] = useState('')` bound to value/onChange (kept name='bodyHtml' + required so createTemplate still receives it). Added a 'Generate with AI' sub-panel above the body field using the existing .landing-ai/.landing-ai-title/.ai-files/.ai-generate/.field/.button classes: prompt textarea (aiPrompt), optional <input type='file' accept='image/*' multiple> with removable chips (.ai-files + X icon), a 'Generate with AI' button (aiLoading -> 'Generating…' + disabled), and inline error via <div className='auth-message error'>. handleGenerate builds FormData {prompt=aiPrompt, kind='email', files}, POSTs to /api/generate-content, on !res.ok sets aiError(data.error), on success calls setBodyHtml(data.html). NO auto-save: generated HTML only lands in bodyHtml state; the existing 'Create template' button still calls createTemplate on explicit submit. The helper note was strengthened to say the {{link}} tracking link is added automatically by the AI.

Edit page: converted via the preferred thin-server-component approach. src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/page.tsx stays a server component that fetches the template (existing supabase query) and passes id/name/subject/body_html as props to a new client child component src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/EditTemplateForm.tsx. EditTemplateForm holds the AI sub-panel + controlled bodyHtml (initialised from template.body_html), submits via <form action={updateTemplate}> with the hidden id input and the SubmitButton component preserved. Same handleGenerate (kind='email', no auto-save).

Contract preserved: field names name/subject/bodyHtml unchanged; createTemplate/updateTemplate save flows unchanged (actions.ts not touched). {{link}} placeholder is enforced server-side by the FEAT-001 email system instruction (kind='email') and both helper notes still mention {{link}}.

Verification: `npm run build` PASS (exit 0, all routes incl. /dashboard/templates/create and /dashboard/templates/[id]/edit compiled). `npm run lint` PASS (exit 0, no errors/warnings after removing an unused Link import from EditTemplateForm). grep over src/app/dashboard/templates confirms both create page and EditTemplateForm wire fetch('/api/generate-content') with form.append('kind','email') and setBodyHtml(data.html); textareas are controlled (value={bodyHtml}); handleGenerate does not call createTemplate/updateTemplate.
